correctness.rationale: Exact finite domain: 743 exhaustive faces; 367 verified pivot-matching pairs; 2816 Hasse arrows tested and directed acyclic, leaving one zero-cell plus seven three-cells; independent mod-two simplicial boundary ranks 15,73,135,86,42,14,2. Every one of the 384 B4 elements was constructed. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces and independently enumerated orbit incompatibility polynomials agree with the claimed formula on all 384. Rational character equality yields the module isomorphism; translation Fourier multiplicities 3 for trivial, 1 for each weight-three, 0 otherwise. Quotient rational homology follows from finite-group invariants after barycentric subdivision. All code and actual output are included.
